docs.title: 💧 DripsLens Documentation
docs.text:
Real-Time Analytics Engine & Search Platform for the Drips Wave Ecosystem

Welcome to the official developer documentation for DripsLens. DripsLens makes the Drips Wave ecosystem trackable, searchable, and verifiable by providing real-time indexing of Soroban smart contract events, repository signal tracking, contributor leaderboard ranking, WASM bytecode health scoring, and state storage TTL monitoring.

docs.title: 🚀 Quick Navigation
docs.text: -   :material-pillar:{ .lg .middle } **[System Architecture](architecture.md)**      ---      Explore the high-level monorepo design, FastAPI routes, async worker processes, and database layout.  -   :material-pipe:{ .lg .middle } **[Ingestion Pipeline](ingestion-pipeline.md)**      ---      Deep dive into Soroban RPC polling, GitHub REST API client, Horizon verification, and tenacity retries.  -   :material-database:{ .lg .middle } **[Data Models](data-models.md)**      ---      Inspect the SQLAlchemy 2.0 async relational schemas: repos, issues, contributors, contracts, and events.  -   :material-api:{ .lg .middle } **[API Reference](api-reference.md)**      ---      Detailed specification of public REST endpoints, query filters, pagination, and Server-Sent Events (SSE).

docs.title: ⚡ Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• Stellar Horizon & Soroban Ingestion: Resilient background workers polling JSON-RPC 2.0 (getEvents, getHealth) and REST APIs with exponential backoff.
  • Fault-Tolerant Rate Limiting: Tenacity retry policies handling HTTP 429 and 503 errors gracefully with dynamic Retry-After header extraction.
  • Automated Database Migrations: Seamless schema provisioning and upgrades via alembic upgrade head across PostgreSQL and SQLite.
  • WASM Bytecode Health Engine: Inspects contract footprint, size thresholds, and function exports to generate actionable health scores (0–100).
  • Time-to-Live (TTL) Rent Boundaries: Proactively computes remaining live days until contract instance archival to alert developers.
  • DAG Invocation Topology: Discovers inter-contract call graphs and outputs node/edge graph data for topological analysis.
  • Live Event Streaming (SSE): Real-time broadcast channel powered by sse-starlette for monitoring agents and dashboard UIs.

docs.title: 🛠 Tech Stack
docs.text:
• Runtime: Python 3.12+
  • API Framework: FastAPI & Starlette
  • Async ORM: SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Asyncpg & Aiosqlite)
  • Migrations: Alembic
  • Task Scheduling: APScheduler (AsyncIOScheduler)
  • Resilience Engine: Tenacity
  • Caching: Redis
  • Real-Time Streaming: SSE-Starlette
  • Blockchain Connectivity: Stellar SDK & Soroban RPC 2.0

docs.title: 🏛 System Architecture
docs.text: DripsLens is engineered as a high-throughput, monorepo analytics platform designed to bridge off-chain repository bounties with on-chain Stellar smart contracts.

docs.title: 1. Unified Asynchronous Lifespan
docs.text: DripsLens leverages FastAPI's modern lifespan context manager (app/main.py). Upon server initialization: 1. Schema integrity is verified and automatically updated with run_database_migrations() executing alembic upgrade head. 2. The asynchronous APScheduler instance boots non-blocking background workers. 3. Upon process termination, workers gracefully flush pending operations and shut down cleanly.

docs.title: 2. Multi-Engine Storage Layer
docs.text: The storage tier utilizes SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async supporting: - PostgreSQL (asyncpg): Production enterprise deployment on Render. - SQLite (aiosqlite): Local development and hermetic CI testing using in-memory databases (:memory:). - Driver Translation: Automatic normalization ensures synchronous Alembic runners connect via standard psycopg2 or sqlite3 without conflicting with async connection pools. - Pre-Ping & Reconnection: Connection pools are configured with pool_pre_ping=True and pool_recycle=300 to automatically recover from dropped database sockets without interrupting active HTTP requests or background jobs.

docs.title: 3. Fault-Tolerant Resilience
docs.text: All external I/O bound requests (Stellar Horizon, Soroban RPC, GitHub REST) are governed by exponential backoff retry algorithms built with tenacity. HTTP 429 rate limits, secondary abuse detection, and HTTP 503 transient service outages are handled automatically without bubbling unhandled exceptions to background worker threads.

docs.title: 🗄️ Data Models
docs.text: DripsLens models entities using modern SQLAlchemy 2.0 Declarative Mapping. Relational schemas are managed via Alembic migrations located in app/db/migrations/versions/.

docs.title: 1. Repo (app/models/repo.py)
docs.text:
Tracks approved Drips Wave repositories, language stacks, and health scoring.

Field Type Description id Integer Primary Key, Indexed name String Unique repository full name (owner/repo), Indexed language String Primary programming language (e.g., Python, Rust), Indexed multiplier Integer Drips Wave bounty multiplier (Default: 1) issue_count Integer Total number of currently open bounty issues last_activity DateTime Timestamp of latest repository commit or event health_score Integer Computed health metric score from 0 to 100 is_verified Boolean Flag indicating valid Stellar Horizon account association

docs.title: 2. Issue (app/models/issue.py)
docs.text:
Tracks open tasks, complexity tiers, and point values.

Field Type Description id Integer Primary Key, Indexed title String Issue title url String Canonical GitHub issue URL, Unique repo_id Integer Foreign Key referencing repos.id complexity String Complexity classification: Trivial, Medium, or High points Integer Points awarded: 100 (Trivial), 150 (Medium), 200 (High) is_claimed Boolean True if assignees exist; False otherwise

docs.title: 3. Contributor (app/models/contributor.py)
docs.text:
Tracks developer leaderboard rankings across the ecosystem.

Field Type Description id Integer Primary Key, Indexed github_username String Unique GitHub username, Indexed merged_prs Integer Cumulative merged pull requests points_earned Integer Cumulative bounty points accrued

docs.title: 4. SorobanContract (app/models/soroban.py)
docs.text:
Represents an on-chain smart contract deployed to the Stellar network.

Field Type Description id String 56-character C... contract public identifier, Primary Key wasm_id String Hexadecimal hash or identifier of compiled WASM bytecode health_score Integer Quality score derived from bytecode analysis (0–100) is_verified Boolean Verification status of contract interface

docs.title: 5. ContractEvent (app/models/soroban.py)
docs.text:
Event logs emitted by smart contracts on the Soroban network.

Field Type Description id String Unique event envelope hash / identifier, Primary Key contract_id String Foreign Key referencing soroban_contracts.id topic String Event topic string data JSON Structured payload data associated with the event ledger_sequence Integer Ledger sequence number in which the transaction closed

docs.title: 6. StorageMetric (app/models/soroban.py)
docs.text:
Tracks state storage rent and archival limits.

Field Type Description id Integer Auto-incrementing Primary Key contract_id String Foreign Key referencing soroban_contracts.id live_until_ledger_seq Integer Target ledger sequence after which state archival triggers

docs.title: 🔄 Ingestion Pipeline
docs.text: The DripsLens Ingestion Pipeline coordinates data collection across on-chain Stellar smart contracts, off-chain GitHub issue bounties, and contributor activity signals.

docs.title: Ingestion Workflow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Sch as APScheduler Worker
    participant Ver as StellarVerifier
    participant GH as GitHubClient
    participant RPC as SorobanClient
    participant DB as Relational Database

    Note over Sch: Interval Trigger (15m / 30m)

    rect rgb(240, 248, 255)
        Note right of Sch: Soroban Contract Event Pipeline
        Sch->>RPC: getEvents(startLedger)
        alt 429 Rate Limit / 503 Outage
            RPC-->>RPC: Tenacity Exponential Backoff Retry
        end
        RPC-->>Sch: List of Contract Events
        Sch->>DB: Upsert ContractEvent & StorageMetric
    end

    rect rgb(255, 245, 245)
        Note right of Sch: Ecosystem Repository & Issue Pipeline
        Sch->>GH: get_json(/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues)
        alt Primary or Secondary Rate Limit (403/429)
            GH-->>GH: Read Retry-After Header & Sleep Backoff
        end
        GH-->>Sch: Open Issues (Filter PRs, Map Points)
        Sch->>Ver: verify_account(repo.stellar_account)
        Ver-->>Sch: Verification Status (True/False)
        Sch->>DB: Update Repo Counts & Issue Bounties
    end

docs.title: 1. Tenacity Exponential Backoff
docs.text: DripsLens eliminates brittle network polling by encapsulating HTTP requests with AsyncRetrying: - Initial Wait: 1 second base backoff with randomized jitter to prevent thundering herd spikes. - Maximum Backoff: 10 seconds upper bound per retry cycle. - Retry Count: 3 attempts before graceful fallback. - Monitored Exceptions: httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ReadTimeout, httpx.WriteTimeout, StellarHorizonRateLimitError, StellarHorizonServiceUnavailableError, GitHubRetryableRateLimit.

docs.title: 2. GitHub Rate Limit Detection
docs.text: GitHub API enforcement separates primary hourly quotas from secondary concurrency limits: - Primary Limit (HTTP 403 & X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0): Detected immediately; logs reset timestamp (X-RateLimit-Reset) and raises GitHubRateLimited to prevent further wasteful requests. - Secondary Limit / 429 (Retry-After Header): Extracts sleep duration, applies jittered delay, and retries the request safely. - Pull Request Filtering: The /issues endpoint inherently returns pull requests. The ingestion parser filters out items containing a pull_request key to ensure accurate bounty indexing.

docs.title: 3. Horizon RPC & Account Verification
docs.text: Stellar account validation checks public key strings (G... 56 characters) directly against the Horizon /accounts/{id} endpoint: - HTTP 200: Account exists; parses native balance and marks repo as verified. - HTTP 404: Account not found on the specified network; flags as unverified without throwing errors. - HTTP 429 / 503: Exponential backoff retry; if exhausted, gracefully falls back to unverified mode rather than stopping scheduler loops.

docs.title: 4. Background Job Wrapper
docs.text: All APScheduler jobs are wrapped with resilient_job_wrapper and execute_with_db_reconnect: - Catch transient database socket resets. - Log error context with execution metadata. - Prevent unhandled exceptions from terminating APScheduler worker threads.
